text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Immediately after the Representative 
Exchange Race, El Condor Pasa, who had 
worked hard alongside her as a partner, 
declines her spot as a Japan 
representative.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running against each other with all their 
might brought understanding: <chrname>'s true 
strength is worthy of standing on the 
world stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reason she came to Japan, the lifelong 
dream she had staked everything on—she 
could entrust it to <chrname>, knowing they would 
fulfill it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she had predicted, <chrname> earned the 
right to challenge the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reaching out toward the world for the sake 
of El Condor Pasa's tears. Fulfilling the 
hopes of the dream entrusted by a friend.
